typedDataPolicy: Complete typed buffers are cryptographically committed by SHA-256, type, logical length and byte length in each original snapshot. Production tests recompute every full buffer identity and whole-model checksum; source image bytes and complete original algorithms remain in the repository. Full private byte captures remain immutable authoring evidence; repeated photograph/output bytes are not duplicated in the public fixtures.
